ground.description: The white backlight: the LCD's ground, behind every figure (#204).

ink.description: The LCD's ink: every figure, caption, rule and segment. The ghosts are this ink drawn at a ninth of its strength, with an opacity rather than a colour of their own.

shade.description: The ground a step darker, for the house's raised and inset surfaces on what this theme leaves to the house: the pop-ups, the change notifications and the lists' own blocks.

rule.description: The house's rules and chips on those pages, a second step darker than the ground.

caption.description: The house's label grey turned over: the ink at four fifths over the ground.

dim.description: The house's dim text turned over: the ink at nine twentieths over the ground, which the absent readings take.

data.note: Every figure on the LCD is the seven-segment face, the house's pages included, so that their own layouts cut their cells for it and shed by their own rules (#204).

digit.note: DSEG7 Classic Regular: every glyph is a cell of 0.816 em, its ink 0.099 to 0.717.

special.note: The colon is 0.2 em and the full stop none, lighting the point of the cell before it.

digit.note: DSEG7 Classic Bold, the same cell as Regular.

gear.note: The gear is a cell like any other in a segment face.
